import sqlite3
import json

db_path = '/workspace/data.sqlite'
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
cur = conn.cursor()

def exe(sql):
    cur.execute(sql)
    return cur.fetchone()[0]

q1 = \"\"\"SELECT
  (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Bitcoin revenue' AND period_end='2024-12-31' AND months=12)
  -
  (SELECT amount FROM costs WHERE category='Bitcoin costs' AND period_end='2024-12-31' AND months=12)\"\"\"

q2 = \"\"\"SELECT
  (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Bitcoin revenue' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12)
  -
  (SELECT amount FROM costs WHERE category='Bitcoin costs' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12)\"\"\"

q3 = \"\"\"SELECT
  (((SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Bitcoin revenue' AND period_end='2024-12-31' AND months=12) -
   (SELECT amount FROM costs WHERE category='Bitcoin costs' AND period_end='2024-12-31' AND months=12)) -
   ((SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Bitcoin revenue' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12) -
    (SELECT amount FROM costs WHERE category='Bitcoin costs' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12))) * 100.0 /
   ((SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Bitcoin revenue' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12) -
    (SELECT amount FROM costs WHERE category='Bitcoin costs' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12))\"\"\"

q4 = \"\"\"SELECT
  ((SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Bitcoin revenue' AND period_end='2024-12-31' AND months=12) -
   (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Bitcoin revenue' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12)) * 100.0 /
  ((SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Total net revenue' AND period_end='2024-12-31' AND months=12) -
   (SELECT amount FROM revenues WHERE category='Total net revenue' AND period_end='2023-12-31' AND months=12))\"\"\"

print(exe(q1))
print(exe(q2))
print(exe(q3))
print(exe(q4))
"
